description.value: Fresgo Inn is an American-cuisine restaurant located on King George Boulevard, a major arterial road through Surrey. It has operated under the Fresgo Inn name and is tagged in OSM as a sit-down restaurant. Cyclists passing through the King George corridor may find it a convenient meal stop, though current operating status should be verified before visiting.
